definition: Ben Goertzel is a computer scientist, artificial intelligence (AI) researcher, and businessman.
details: He helped popularize the term artificial general intelligence (AGI). Goertzel also had a long-running research-funding relationship with Jeffrey Epstein, which continued after Epstein's 2008 conviction for sex offenses; Goertzel later said that accepting Epstein's funding had been a mistake.

explainer.lead: Ben Goertzel is an American computer scientist and AI researcher (born 1966). His work spans artificial intelligence and artificial general intelligence.

contributions.name: Goertzel is the founder and CEO of SingularityNET, a project which was founded to distribute artificial intelligence data via blockchains.

timeline.what: Goertzel graduated with a PhD in mathematics from Temple University under the supervision of Avi Lin in 1990, at age 23.
